why: Each figure has a frame, a stand and a small black symbol. The frame decides the stand: curved star frame gets a T stand, square gets two legs, drum gets a triangle stand. Each row also uses each frame and each symbol (cross, triangle, dot) once. Row 3 needs the star frame with a T stand and a triangle inside: option 4. Option 6 has the right frame and stand but a dot, which is already used in row 3.
trick: Split each figure into parts (frame, stand, inner mark) and check each part separately across the row.
